verses.fafi-l-ifa-i-ifa-un-fa-awfu-c1-v1: fafī l-ʾīfāʾi ʾīfāʾu faʾawfū wanaqḍu l-ʿahdi min fiʿli l-fusūqi
verses.fafi-l-ifa-i-ifa-un-fa-awfu-c1-v2: ʾalā ʾuslūbunā ʾuslūbu khayri waqudwatinā bihā khayru r-rafīqi
verses.fafi-l-ifa-i-ifa-un-fa-awfu-c1-v3: ʾilahī thabbitan qadamī ʿalayhā bika l-manjātu min qadami zalūqi
